fix: Load the JWT secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the leaked value.
Use a parameterized query such as `LIKE $1` with `['%' + q + '%']`.
Use path.basename on the name (or resolve and verify the result stays within REPORT_DIR) before sending.
Hash passwords with a salted slow KDF such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of hosts/schemes and block private, loopback and link-local addresses.
Check that the user owns the ticket or is an admin (e.g. add requireAdmin or an owner_id condition) before deleting.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate format against an allow-list such as csv/json.
